subsystem.name: GenericRuntimeObjects
subsystem.responsibility: UI widget and runtime-container objects: a scrollable sprite-tile list with an embedded linked list, a text-input widget, a media-buffer playback-list renderer, a combined Bink-video/font resource widget with reload/content-changed vtable contract, render-bounds and bitmap clip forwarders, two generic linked-list containers, a global one-time custom memory-pool allocator, and an audio stream file object. UI renderers reach shared resources through GlobalAccessor_5150(&unk_7CDE00) and the shared default string byte_5EA438.

summary: Derived architecture proposal for 19 validated functions in scope generic_runtime_objects. Two packet-DERIVED owners anchor classes: 0x0048D2B0 (LinkedListNodeAppend) joins 0x0048D230 (LinkedListDestructionWithVTableCall) on the shared this+0x31C..0x340 list state block as the LinkedList class, and 0x0048D9D0 forms MediaBufferPlaybackManager. All remaining functions carry packet-UNKNOWN owners and are grouped into GUESS classes keyed on shared field regions: ScrollableUIList (0x0048CCB0, shares the 0x31C/0x324/0x328 list region), TextInputWidget (0x0048B9C0), ConditionalRenderWidget (0x0048D6F0), ResourceWidget (0x0048E250/0x0048E3A0/0x0048E4B0, sharing the this+0xE4..0xF8 resource/metric region and vtable slots 44/160), MutexResourceCleanup (0x0048E890, kept apart from ResourceWidget because this+0xE8/0xEC carry incompatible roles), ViewportClipForwarder (0x0048F0B0), DoublyLinkedList (0x0048F5D0), BitmapSurface (0x0048FC80/0x0048FCA0), DelegationDispatchWidget (0x0048FDF0), CustomMemoryPoolAllocator (0x004906E0/0x00490940 over globals 0x7CD9C8/0x7CD9CC/0x7CD9D0), and AudioStreamFile (0x00491EE0/0x00491F60). A shared 10-arg clip-and-emit pattern (GlobalAccessor_5150 + F_10ParamForwarder) is factored into the SurfaceBlitForwarder interface.

function_roles.role: Text-input widget render: resolve font (this+0xC8, path at +0x40, default byte_5EA438), prime measurement context, resolve layout child, mask edit buffer at this+0x2F0 with '*' when password flag 0xE2, append cursor glyph (0xE0 & 0xE1), measure/left-scroll against view width, BitmapDraw, write geometry to out params, call vtable+44 post-render; returns 0

Sprite/tile batch render for a scrollable UI list: clip-rect (0x14..0x20) and tile-count (0x328) guards, camera-derived column sweep over the linked list at 0x31C/0x324, clamped sprite sub-rect emission via F_10ParamForwarder, second hover/overlay pass via sub_486830 and ConditionalDelegation_6460, visible-region publish via vtable+16; returns 0 or -1

Destroy the object's singly linked list at 0x31C: per-node guard on active flag byte node+0xC and first dword, indirect vtable destructor call, FreeWrapper_7bcf on each node, then zero the state block 0x31C..0x340 except direction byte 0x33C set to 1

Append a value to the doubly linked list: allocate 8-byte data node and 16-byte list node, link at tail 0x320, bump count 0x328, recompute size statistics, notify change via vtable slot 44; returns 1 on success, 0 on allocation failure

Conditional UI render dispatch: early return 0 when flag at 0xEC is clear; else fetch UI string, copy it into buffer 0x40 via sub_498560 when non-null, and delegate rendering to UILargeRenderDispatcher 0x00488BE0

Render media-buffer playback list: cache item layout (X 0x108..0x114, Y 0x118..0x124), position list iterator, string-table lookup into byte_5EC4CC, UIMessageDispatch for item 3, clip-bounds multi-item pass gated on playback states 3/4/5/8/9, delegate surface fill and invoke vtable #4/#11; returns 0

Bink video render-or-reload: compare expected path 0xB0 vs loaded path 0xE8; on match with unloaded state 0xE4 null and handle 0xE0 non-null render one frame at (0xC,0x4) via BinkVideoFrameRender and notify vtable+44; on mismatch invoke vtable+160 reload; returns 0

Font resource load: free existing resource 0xE4, build path from dir 0xB0, base dir dword_5EC3F0 and name 0xB8 (defaulting to byte_5EA438), create resource, clear metrics 0xE8/0xEC, on failure branch clear active byte 0xF8 and copy glyph width/height from resource +0xC/+0x10 into 0xF0/0xF4 and configure DSP parameter; returns 1/0

Per-object Bink frame render/reload driver: compare loaded path 0xFC vs reference 0xB0; on difference invoke vtable+160 reload; else when resource 0xE4 present and flag 0xF8 set render a frame, clear flag, blit rendered surface, notify vtable+44 and repaint vtable+16; returns 0
Clean up a mutex/semaphore resource: release handle at 0xE8 via MutexSemaphoreCleanup when non-null, clear it, unconditionally zero field 0xEC; returns 1

Guarded render-bounds forwarder: requires a2, flag 0x17C and source pointer 0xE4; clip a3/a4 against bounds 0x120/0x140, clamp source width/height (*(this+0xE4)+0x1C/+0x20) against 0x124/0x144, fetch render context via GlobalAccessor_5150 and forward 10 args to F_10ParamForwarder; returns forwarded result

Append a 16-byte node (data pointer + byte flag) to a doubly linked list at 0xF0/0xF4/0xF8/0xFC: skip entirely on null data, allocate via OperatorNewNhMallocWrapper(16), link head/cursor/tail, increment element count
Copy nested external bounds: store source pointer into 0x38, read width from *(a2+12)+28 into 0xC and height from *(a2+12)+32 into 0x10; returns the nested source struct pointer

Guarded bitmap blit with source/destination clipping: requires 0x38 and descriptor base 0x44; clip a2/a3 against bounds 0x24/0x1C, clamp source width/height (descriptor +0x1C/+0x20) against 0x28/0x20, fetch render context and forward 10 args to F_10ParamForwarder; returns forwarded result

Conditional delegation dispatch: when sub-object 0x30 is non-null, run ConditionalDelegation_6460 with the sub-object's slot 33, accumulate incoming offsets via OffsetAccumulator, invoke the sub-object's vtable slot 0x2C with literal 1 and return its result; null-guard path returns an uninitialized result

One-time custom memory-pool allocator init: guard byte_7CD9C8 bit 0, allocate pool struct/descriptor/32-entry array, link free-list nodes, store pool in dword_7CD9CC and allocator handle in dword_7CD9D0, register ResourceLinkedListTeardown; returns pointer to dword_7CD9CC

Pool node pop-or-alloc over the global container: pop free-list head or allocate node + 68-byte block, init four dwords, append to pool list; dealloc-walk unlinks/destroys a matched node; ends with ShortComputation_16e0; returns the resulting node pointer

Audio stream open wrapper: open read stream "rb" into this[0], optionally open write stream "wt" into this[1] when flag 0x19A is set, read/init audio stream buffer from the read stream, configure the write stream; returns 0
Three-handle resource cleanup: dispatch/close this[0] via StreamFileTypeCheckWithDispatch and this[1]/this[2] via FileCloseWithLock when non-null, zero all three slots; returns 0

classes.name: LinkedList
classes.responsibility: Doubly linked-list container holding value nodes. Appends a value node and notifies via vtable slot 44 (0x0048D2B0) and destroys the list, freeing every node through FreeWrapper_7bcf and resetting the state block 0x31C..0x340 with direction byte 0x33C left at 1 (0x0048D230).

classes.name: ScrollableUIList
classes.responsibility: Sprite/tile batch renderer for a scrollable UI list (0x0048CCB0). Sweeps the linked list held at this+0x31C/0x324 under camera-derived column math, emits clamped sprite sub-rects through F_10ParamForwarder, and publishes the visible region back to the caller. Shares the 0x31C..0x340 list state block with LinkedList on a GUESS basis.

classes.name: TextInputWidget
classes.responsibility: Text-input widget renderer (0x0048B9C0): resolves the font sub-object, masks the edit buffer when the password flag is set, appends the cursor glyph, left-scrolls overflow, draws via BitmapDraw and invokes the post-render vtable callback.

classes.name: ConditionalRenderWidget
classes.responsibility: Conditional UI render dispatcher (0x0048D6F0): skips rendering while the flag at 0xEC is clear, copies a fetched UI string into the buffer at 0x40, and delegates the actual draw to UILargeRenderDispatcher.

classes.name: MediaBufferPlaybackManager
classes.responsibility: Renders the media-buffer playback list (0x0048D9D0): caches per-item layout coordinates, walks the item list to the clamped current index, looks display strings up in the string table, dispatches UI messages, and for playback states 3/4/5/8/9 runs a clip-tested extra-item pass; ends by delegating a surface fill and invoking vtable #4/#11.

classes.name: ResourceWidget
classes.responsibility: Resource widget holding a single loadable resource at this+0xE4 with path/metric state around it. Loads font resources (0x0048E3A0), renders Bink video frames or reloads when the path changes (0x0048E250, 0x0048E4B0). Shares vtable slots 44 (content changed) and 160 (reload).

classes.name: MutexResourceCleanup
classes.responsibility: Cleanup helper for a mutex/semaphore-style handle (0x0048E890): releases the handle at 0xE8 via MutexSemaphoreCleanup and zeroes the secondary field at 0xEC. Kept separate from ResourceWidget because 0xE8/0xEC carry incompatible roles there.

classes.name: ViewportClipForwarder
classes.responsibility: Guarded render-bounds forwarder (0x0048F0B0): clips requested source offsets against stored viewport bounds, clamps the source rectangle from the pointed object at 0xE4, and forwards the computed parameters to F_10ParamForwarder.

classes.name: DoublyLinkedList
classes.responsibility: Doubly linked list container at 0xF0..0xFC (0x0048F5D0): appends 16-byte nodes holding a data pointer and a byte flag, linking head/cursor/tail and bumping the element count. Node member semantics are DERIVED from the raw body, not from the packet's typed field list.

classes.name: BitmapSurface
classes.responsibility: Bitmap render-surface object: copies nested source bounds (0x0048FC80) and performs guarded, clipped bitmap blits (0x0048FCA0) that clamp a source rectangle from the descriptor base at 0x44 and forward to F_10ParamForwarder. Both methods are called by GameFilterSetup (0x00477830) and ProfileBitmapBrowser (0x00477CB0).

classes.name: DelegationDispatchWidget
classes.responsibility: Conditional delegation dispatcher (0x0048FDF0): when the sub-object at 0x30 is present, runs ConditionalDelegation_6460 with the sub-object's slot 33, accumulates incoming offsets, and invokes the sub-object's vtable slot 0x2C with literal 1.

classes.name: CustomMemoryPoolAllocator
classes.responsibility: Global custom memory-pool allocator: one-time construction of the pool and free list with an allocator handle (0x004906E0) and node pop-or-alloc over the global container (0x00490940). Backed by global byte_7CD9C8 / dword_7CD9CC / dword_7CD9D0 (see MemoryPoolAllocatorGlobalState contract) and consumed by Accessor/GlobalDataRead.

classes.name: AudioStreamFile
classes.responsibility: Audio stream file object: opens read and optional write streams with mode strings (0x00491EE0) and closes/zeroes the three handle slots (0x00491F60). The read/write stream handles and the write-mode flag at 0x19A suggest an audio stream file, but the concrete owner type is unproven.

interfaces.name: SurfaceBlitForwarder
interfaces.purpose: Shared 10-argument clipped-surface-emit contract: a function fetches the global render context via GlobalAccessor_5150(&unk_7CDE00) and forwards a texture/source rectangle plus computed clip parameters to F_10ParamForwarder. Implemented by the widget renderers in this packet.

interfaces.name: ResourceReloadNotifier
interfaces.purpose: vtable contract on resource widgets: slot 44 (byte offset 0x2C) is invoked with literal argument 1 to signal content changed, and slot 160 (byte offset 0xA0) triggers resource reload/reinitialize. Both ResourceWidget render methods rely on it.

compatibility_contracts.name: TextInputEditBufferContract
compatibility_contracts.description: TextInputRender (0x0048B9C0) requires an edit-buffer pointer at this+0x2F0 with 256-byte scratch semantics: when the password flag byte at this+0xE2 is set the buffer is masked with '*' (0x2A), and when the visibility flag 0xE0 AND the cursor flag 0xE1 are set the cursor glyph word_5CC214 is appended. The font sub-object path at this+0xC8/+0x40 falls back to the shared default string byte_5EA438.

compatibility_contracts.name: ScrollableTileListStateBlock
compatibility_contracts.description: The scrollable UI list and its linked-list container share the state block this+0x31C..0x340: head 0x31C, tail 0x320, first-element/cursor 0x324, count 0x328; destruction (0x0048D230) zeroes the block except the direction byte at 0x33C which is set to 1. List nodes are 4-byte linked via +0x4 next with an active byte at +0xC.

compatibility_contracts.name: DoublyLinkedListNodeLayout
compatibility_contracts.description: DoublyLinkedListAppend (0x0048F5D0) appends 16-byte nodes holding a data pointer at +0, next at +4, prev at +8 and a byte flag at +12, with container head 0xF0, tail 0xF4, cursor 0xF8 and element count 0xFC incremented on append. Nothing is appended when the data pointer is null.

compatibility_contracts.name: BinkVideoFrameRenderSignature
compatibility_contracts.description: BinkVideoFrameRender(context, x, y, 32) draws one video frame where context comes from GlobalAccessor_5150(&unk_7CDE00) and (x,y) is the stored render position. After a render, vtable slot 44 (byte offset 0x2C) is called with literal 1 to signal content changed; vtable slot 160 (byte offset 0xA0) triggers a reload when the path differs.

compatibility_contracts.name: AudioStreamOpenModeStrings
compatibility_contracts.description: FileOpenWrapperWithModeCheck (0x00491EE0) opens the read stream with mode string "rb" (global 0x005BE828) into this[0] and, when the write-mode flag byte at this+0x19A is set, an optional write stream with "wt" (global 0x005C302C) into this[1]; the flag is cleared when the write stream cannot be created.

compatibility_contracts.name: MemoryPoolAllocatorGlobalState
compatibility_contracts.description: CustomMemoryPoolAllocatorInit (0x004906E0) is one-time: guarded by byte_7CD9C8 bit 0, it builds the pool, stores the pool pointer in dword_7CD9CC and the allocator handle in dword_7CD9D0, and registers ResourceLinkedListTeardown (0x00490850) as teardown callback. Accessor/GlobalDataRead depend on this global state.

unresolved: The three functions sharing the this+0x31C..0x340 list region carry conflicting packet owner names: 0x0048D2B0 is LinkedList/DERIVED, 0x0048CCB0 is Scrollable_UI_List_Rendering/UNKNOWN, 0x0048D230 is UnknownObject. They are placed in LinkedList (0x0048D230/0x0048D2B0) and ScrollableUIList (0x0048CCB0) and linked by a GUESS 'shares_linked_list_state_block' dependency; common ownership is not proven by the packet.

Eight read-only obj fields (obj+0x8..+0x24) flagged by 0x0048CCB0 packet facts do not appear in the raw decompiled body; they are probably the child-object layout consumed by F_10ParamForwarder and are left unresolved.
The vtable slot identities of ScrollableUIList (camera getters 24/28/32/36, callbacks 8/12/16/20) are not named by the packet.

MediaBufferPlaybackManager parameters a2-a5 are never referenced in the body; the playback-state enum values 3/4/5/8/9 returned by ShortComputation_6720 are unnamed; the DualFieldRead clip-bounds source is unknown; and the function has no static callers so its invocation context is unknown.

The nested delegation-object fields (obj+0x18/0x1C/0x24/0x2C in TextInputRender and the obj+8..0x24 region) and the rectangle-delta layout semantics of the delegation child cannot be recovered from this packet.

ResourceWidget and MutexResourceCleanup both touch this+0xE8/0xEC but with incompatible roles (path/metrics vs mutex handle/secondary); per rule 8 they are kept as separate classes rather than merged.
global byte_5EA438 is the shared default string substituted whenever a path/name pointer is null across nearly every UI renderer in this packet; its content is unknown.
GlobalAccessor_5150(&unk_7CDE00) returns the render surface/context used by SurfaceBlitForwarder; the identity and structure of the global behind 0x007CDE00 are not determinable from this packet.

field:this:0x000000B4 (0x0048FDF0) is recorded as read by deterministic facts but the raw source passes the sub-object's dword 33 (offset 0x84) as the delegation parameter; the two cannot be reconciled from this packet alone.
The 0x0048F5D0 packet field entry lists this+0xFC as read-only (R) yet the decompiled body increments it (++this[63]); the R/W classification is inconsistent with the observed write.
BinkVideoFrameRender's literal argument 32 (bit depth or flags) is unresolved, and which path string is requested vs loaded is inferred rather than confirmed.
ObjectCreationWithRollbackOnFailure in 0x0048E3A0 reads glyph metrics from the resource object on the failure branch, suggesting partial creation on failure; the exact contract is unclear.

The pool struct and free-list node layouts in 0x004906E0 are DERIVED from dword/byte indices; when the descriptor allocation fails the decompiled body still dereferences the descriptor inside the walk loop, so the original guard may be unrecoverable.
global dword_8AFE64 (0x008AFE64) is packet-listed as read by 0x0048E3A0 and 0x0048E890 but does not appear in the raw source text of either.

The indirect vtable destructor target in 0x0048D230 is node-type dependent; the state-block fields 0x320..0x340 (tail/counts/scroll state) and the 0x33C direction-byte semantics are not individually established.
The constant 10 (margin) in 0x0048F0B0's y-clip and height clamp and the 0x120/0x140 (scroll offset vs viewport maximum) interpretation are not proven by the packet.

DoublyLinkedList node member semantics (data +0, next +4, prev +8, byte flag +12) are DERIVED from the raw source, not part of the packet's typed field list; the owning class of the four list fields at 0xF0..0xFC is unknown.
0x0048E250/0x0048E4B0/0x0048F0B0/0x0048FCA0 have no static callers in the packet, so the external trigger conditions for their render/reload/repaint paths are unknown.
sub_587DD0's copy semantics (plain vs bounded string copy) in 0x0048B9C0 are inferred only from its 255-length argument.
